ios.desc:
SmileTune – Your Smiles, Perfected!

Welcome to SmileTune, a powerful AI-driven face editing app that lets you reshape expressions, enhance your look, and bring your photos to life—with precision and ease. Whether you want to add a subtle smile or dramatic laughter, soften a serious face, adjust your head position, or fine-tune facial details, SmileTune gives you total creative control while keeping your edits natural and authentic.

What You Can Do with SmileTune:

• Expression Transfer – Instantly adjust facial expressions with 100+ templates across 10 moods, from happy to angry and everything in between.

• 3D Face Rotation – Precisely rotate your face in pitch, yaw, and roll directions—adjust a single axis or combine multiple for full control.

• Face Enhancement – Automatically refine your face while preserving its natural look. Customize the intensity for the perfect balance.

• Works on Various Input Types – Edit real photos, AI-generated portraits (AIGC), anime, paintings, and more.

• On-Device AI Processing – All edits are processed locally, ensuring fast performance and complete privacy.

Why Choose SmileTune?

• Easy & Powerful – One-tap transformations or fine-tuned adjustments—you decide.

• Realistic Results – AI-powered edits that look natural, not artificial.

• Privacy First – Your photos never leave your device. No uploads, no cloud storage.

Save & Share Your Way:

• Unlimited Saves with App Logo – Edit and export as many times as you like, with the SmileTune logo included.
• Logo-Free Saves – Use credits to export without the logo. Buy more credits for the best value per save.

Supported Devices:

SmileTune requires a device with 5GB+ RAM due to high memory usage.

iPhones:

• iPhone 12 Pro / Pro Max
• iPhone 13 Pro / Pro Max
• All iPhone 14, 15, and 16 models
• And later devices with 5GB+ RAM

iPads:

• iPad mini with A17 Pro
• iPad Air (5th Gen)
• iPad Air with M2
• iPad Pro 11-inch (2nd Gen)
• iPad Pro 12.9-inch (4th Gen)
• And later models with 5GB+ RAM

Unleash your creativity, refine your expressions, and transform your selfies like never before with SmileTune!
